# Accessibility and Visual Design Update

## Accessibility fixes
- I added a skip link so keyboard users can bypass the navigation and reach the main content quickly.
- I replaced plain text contact details with descriptive links and clear link text to improve screen-reader context.
- I added visible labels, fieldset/legend grouping, and error messages to make the contact form easier to understand and complete.
- I used ARIA live regions and role="alert" feedback so form errors are announced to assistive technologies.
- I improved focus styling on links, form controls, and buttons so keyboard navigation is easier to track.

## Visual design choices
- I used proximity to group related project cards and keep the content visually organized.
- I used repetition in the shared button, card, and navigation styling to create a consistent experience across all pages.
- I kept one color palette across the home, projects, and about pages with a calm blue-teal theme and stronger contrast.

## Contrast notes
- The selected text and background combinations were chosen to meet WCAG AA contrast for body text, headings, links, and form controls.
